package aiprompt

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
)

const (
	maximumOnboardingSemanticRequestBytes     = domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariablesMaximumBytes + 8<<10
	maximumOnboardingSemanticResponseBytes    = 256 << 10
	maximumOnboardingSemanticErrorBytes       = 4 << 10
	maximumOnboardingSemanticExecutionIDRunes = 128
)

type onboardingSemanticExecutionRequest struct {
	IdempotencyKey string                                    `json:"idempotency_key"`
	TemplateCode   string                                    `json:"template_code"`
	LanguageCode   string                                    `json:"language_code"`
	Variables      domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariables `json:"variables"`
}

type onboardingSemanticExecutionResponse struct {
	ExecutionID        string          `json:"execution_id"`
	IdempotencyKey     string          `json:"idempotency_key"`
	TemplateCode       string          `json:"template_code"`
	TemplateVersion    int             `json:"template_version"`
	ProviderCode       string          `json:"provider_code"`
	ProviderModel      string          `json:"provider_model"`
	LanguageCode       string          `json:"language_code"`
	ResponseSchemaCode string          `json:"response_schema_code"`
	ParsedResponse     json.RawMessage `json:"parsed_response"`
	Cached             bool            `json:"cached"`
	CreatedAt          time.Time       `json:"created_at"`
	ExpiresAt          time.Time       `json:"expires_at"`
}

func (client Client) InterpretOnboardingSemantic(ctx context.Context, input domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution, error) {
	normalized, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticRequest(input)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, err
	}
	variablesPayload, err := json.Marshal(normalized.Variables)
	if err != nil || len(variablesPayload) > domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticVariablesMaximumBytes {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(onboardingSemanticExecutionRequest{
		IdempotencyKey: normalized.AIExecutionID,
		TemplateCode:   domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticTemplateCode,
		LanguageCode:   normalized.LanguageCode,
		Variables:      normalized.Variables,
	})
	if err != nil || len(payload) > maximumOnboardingSemanticRequestBytes {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/api/v1/prompts/execute-confidential")
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnavailable
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnavailable
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, mapOnboardingSemanticStatus(response)
	}
	result, err := decodeOnboardingSemanticExecution(response.Body, false)
	if err != nil || result.IdempotencyKey != normalized.AIExecutionID ||
		result.TemplateCode != domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticTemplateCode ||
		result.ResponseSchemaCode != domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode ||
		result.LanguageCode != normalized.LanguageCode {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	return onboardingSemanticExecution(result), nil
}

func (client Client) ReplayOnboardingSemantic(ctx context.Context, aiExecutionID string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution, error) {
	key, err := normalizeOnboardingSemanticExecutionID(aiExecutionID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, err
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpoint("/api/v1/prompts/confidential-executions/" + url.PathEscape(key))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnavailable
	}
	client.authorize(request)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnavailable
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, mapOnboardingSemanticStatus(response)
	}
	result, err := decodeOnboardingSemanticExecution(response.Body, true)
	if err != nil || result.IdempotencyKey != key || result.TemplateCode != domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticTemplateCode ||
		result.ResponseSchemaCode != domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode || result.LanguageCode != "ru" && result.LanguageCode != "en" {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	return onboardingSemanticExecution(result), nil
}

func onboardingSemanticExecution(value onboardingSemanticExecutionResponse) domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution {
	result, _ := decodeOnboardingSemanticResult(value.ParsedResponse)
	return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticExecution{
		Result:          result,
		LanguageCode:    value.LanguageCode,
		TemplateVersion: value.TemplateVersion,
		Cached:          value.Cached,
	}
}

func decodeOnboardingSemanticExecution(reader io.Reader, requireCached bool) (onboardingSemanticExecutionResponse, error) {
	limited := &io.LimitedReader{R: reader, N: maximumOnboardingSemanticResponseBytes + 1}
	encoded, err := io.ReadAll(limited)
	if err != nil || limited.N == 0 {
		return onboardingSemanticExecutionResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	fields, err := exactOnboardingSemanticObject(encoded, []string{
		"execution_id", "idempotency_key", "template_code", "template_version", "provider_code", "provider_model",
		"language_code", "response_schema_code", "parsed_response", "cached", "created_at", "expires_at",
	})
	if err != nil {
		return onboardingSemanticExecutionResponse{}, err
	}
	var result onboardingSemanticExecutionResponse
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(encoded))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return onboardingSemanticExecutionResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return onboardingSemanticExecutionResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	if !validOnboardingSemanticExecutionID(result.ExecutionID) || !validUUIDString(result.IdempotencyKey) ||
		result.TemplateCode != domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticTemplateCode || result.ResponseSchemaCode != domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode ||
		result.TemplateVersion < 1 || !validOnboardingSemanticOpaque(result.ProviderCode, 64) || !validOnboardingSemanticOpaque(result.ProviderModel, 128) ||
		(result.LanguageCode != "ru" && result.LanguageCode != "en") || result.CreatedAt.IsZero() || result.ExpiresAt.IsZero() ||
		!result.ExpiresAt.After(result.CreatedAt) || (requireCached && !result.Cached) {
		return onboardingSemanticExecutionResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	if _, err := decodeOnboardingSemanticResult(fields["parsed_response"]); err != nil {
		return onboardingSemanticExecutionResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	return result, nil
}

func decodeOnboardingSemanticResult(encoded []byte) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult, error) {
	root, err := exactOnboardingSemanticObject(encoded, []string{"schema", "response", "slot_candidates", "questions", "uncertainties"})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{}, err
	}
	if _, err := exactOnboardingSemanticArray(root["slot_candidates"], []string{"slot", "code_value", "text_value", "string_list_value", "integer_value", "confidence_basis_points"}); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{}, err
	}
	if _, err := exactOnboardingSemanticArray(root["questions"], []string{"slot", "question"}); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{}, err
	}
	if _, err := exactOnboardingSemanticArray(root["uncertainties"], []string{"slot", "reason", "detail"}); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{}, err
	}
	var result domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(encoded))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	return domain.NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(result)
}

func exactOnboardingSemanticObject(encoded []byte, required []string) (map[string]json.RawMessage, error) {
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(encoded)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 || trimmed[0] != '{' {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	var object map[string]json.RawMessage
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(trimmed))
	if err := decoder.Decode(&object); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || len(object) != len(required) {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	wanted := make(map[string]struct{}, len(required))
	for _, key := range required {
		wanted[key] = struct{}{}
		value, ok := object[key]
		if !ok || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(value), []byte("null")) {
			return nil, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
	}
	for key := range object {
		if _, ok := wanted[key]; !ok {
			return nil, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
		}
	}
	return object, nil
}

func exactOnboardingSemanticArray(encoded json.RawMessage, required []string) ([]json.RawMessage, error) {
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(encoded)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 || trimmed[0] != '[' || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("null")) {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	var values []json.RawMessage
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(trimmed))
	if err := decoder.Decode(&values); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	for _, value := range values {
		if _, err := exactOnboardingSemanticObject(value, required); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return values, nil
}

func mapOnboardingSemanticStatus(response *http.Response) error {
	code := readOnboardingSemanticErrorCode(response.Body)
	retryAfter := parseOnboardingSemanticRetryAfter(response.Header.Get("Retry-After"))
	switch response.StatusCode {
	case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
		return domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnknown
	case http.StatusConflict:
		// Only the versioned machine code is retryable. A legacy/plain or
		// unknown 409 must remain a conservative idempotency conflict even if a
		// proxy happened to preserve Retry-After from an older producer.
		pending := code == "execution_in_progress"
		if !pending {
			retryAfter = 0
		}
		return &domain.TeacherOnboardingSemanticConflictError{Pending: pending, RetryAfter: retryAfter}
	case http.StatusServiceUnavailable:
		if code == "capability_disabled" {
			return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticCapabilityDisabled
		}
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnavailable
	case http.StatusBadGateway:
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticProviderOutput
	default:
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingSemanticUnavailable
	}
}

func readOnboardingSemanticErrorCode(reader io.Reader) string {
	if reader == nil {
		return ""
	}
	payload, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, maximumOnboardingSemanticErrorBytes))
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	var envelope struct {
		Error struct {
			Code string `json:"code"`
		} `json:"error"`
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(payload))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&envelope); err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(envelope.Error.Code)
}

func parseOnboardingSemanticRetryAfter(value string) int {
	seconds, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(value))
	if err != nil || seconds < 1 || seconds > 3600 {
		return 0
	}
	return seconds
}

func normalizeOnboardingSemanticExecutionID(value string) (string, error) {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(value))
	if err != nil {
		return "", domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingSemantic
	}
	return parsed.String(), nil
}

func validUUIDString(value string) bool {
	_, err := uuid.Parse(strings.TrimSpace(value))
	return err == nil
}

func validOnboardingSemanticExecutionID(value string) bool {
	return validOnboardingSemanticOpaque(value, maximumOnboardingSemanticExecutionIDRunes)
}

func validOnboardingSemanticOpaque(value string, maximum int) bool {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
	return value != "" && utf8.ValidString(value) && utf8.RuneCountInString(value) <= maximum
}

var _ repository.TeacherOnboardingSemanticInterpreter = Client{}
